name: Data Aggregator Layer V1
role: Gather approved raw and structured inputs, attach provenance, classify intake readiness, and prepare records for normalization, evidence packaging, Truth Spine review, Watchtower visibility, Reports, and public/data approval workflows.
owns: summary visibility for Reports and Watchtower
truth_spine_requirement: Claim-like data must be sent to Truth Spine with source/provenance metadata; missing-source or missing-provenance inputs remain blocked or draft.
public_approval_rule: Data Aggregator cannot public-approve data or mark it report-ready.
